notes.title: More Languages for the Free Demo!
notes.content:
For my non-English speaking friends, I have added more languages!

Pachinko TD now supports 10 languages:
[list]
[*]English
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Spanish
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Polish
[*]Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/list]
Due to limited resources, the translations were done using Google Translate.
As I cannot speak all the supported languages, I cannot ensure the quality of the translations!
If you have any suggestions for translation improvements, I would greatly appreciate it if you shared it on [url=https://discord.gg/hVzehcZrRD]Discord[/url].

Enjoy!
